effects.detail: Put two +1/+1 counters on an Army you control. It's also a Goblin. If you don't control an Army, create a 0/0 black Goblin Army creature token first.

proposed_edges.note: Amass Goblins 2; creates the Army token only if none is controlled

schema_extension_requests.rationale: Amass has no mechanic_template in shared_context and no single controlled predicate captures the conditional token-creation-plus-counter compound; represented here via CREATES_OBJECT + ADDS_COUNTER, but a dedicated predicate would preserve the keyword's atomicity.
